title: Mobility Equipment Return, Pickup and Recovery Terms
content:
# Return, Pickup and Recovery Terms — Mobility Equipment

**Terms.** A patient may decline a Mobility Equipment chair before delivery at no charge, except a custom-configured chair whose build has started, which is then treated as delivered. A rented chair is returned only at the patient's own confirmation: a rented chair is returned only after a return-pickup request on this wheelchair record is approved. Pickup follows within the class's pickup lead, in business days; billing stops with the last month that began before the return. A chair recovered damaged beyond normal wear is charged the class's damage fee; a chair still not recovered the class's unreturned period, in days, after the confirmed pickup date is charged the class's unreturned equipment charge, removed if later recovered. An owned chair is never picked up or charged.

## Declining before delivery

| Chair | Declined before delivery |
|---|---|
| not custom-configured | no charge |
| custom-configured, build not started | no charge |
| custom-configured, build started | treated as delivered |

## Return of a rented chair

The approval is read from the system's request record on this wheelchair record: a return-pickup request with the status approved. Without it the rented chair is not returned.

## Charges after pickup

- **Damaged beyond normal wear** on recovery: the class's damage fee.
- **Not recovered** once the unreturned period after the confirmed pickup date has passed: the class's unreturned equipment charge, removed if the chair is later recovered.
- **Owned chair:** never picked up and never charged.

## Billing stop (hypothetical)

With rental months beginning on the 9th and a return on 20 May, the last month billed is the one beginning 9 May, the last month that began before the return.
